name: Barr
text: Barr is the name of a saint of the Outer Hebrides. He is the one who gives a name to the island of Barra. His feast, once marked on a day of September, came to join that of Saint Michael. His name and his day show him to be the same as Barra, the figure also known as Finnbarr.

attributes.attribute: a saint of the Outer Hebrides
eponym of the island of Barra

okr.objective: Record Saint Barr and his bond to Barra.
